We use 's adaptive attention model. The model's encoder uses a pre-trained CNN to represent images as feature vectors (we used ResNet152). A single LSTM layer with rectifier activation transforms the feature vectors into new vectors v g . We concatenate the vector v g with the word embedding vector w t as the input for the decoder.

We assess the quality of generated captions in terms of CIDEr scores ... We measure diversity using different type‑token ratios (TTR) ... we report the absolute number of out‑of‑vocabulary types and tokens ... listener accuracy (L_acc) is reported as well.

We assess the quality of generated captions in terms of CIDEr scores , measuring the overlap with human captions. Since our model generates captions character by character, we report the absolute number of out-of-vocabulary types and tokens (OOV types and tokens)... We measure diversity using different type-token ratios (TTR).
